bio.text: Paul Sand is the Libertarian Party nominee for governor of Idaho in 2026; according to his campaign website, he won the party's primary on May 19, 2026.
According to his campaign website, he is a retired computer software engineer who lives in White Bird, Idaho, grew up in Minnesota, and moved west about 30 years ago.
His website says he served ten years on the White Bird City Council and was a member of the White Bird Volunteer Fire Department.
